notes:
Coalition assignment, not a quest: no Start field, and the walkthrough never names an NPC. The giver is the '## Giver' block stage A resolved from the Scouts' Coalition page -- Task Delegator, Eastern Adoulin (F-9), giver_conflict null -- and that is what start and step 1 use. The table's Rank is 'Contributor', a Scouts' Coalition rank; it gates receiving the assignment, it is NOT gates.level (which is character level), and the schema has no field for it, so it lives here and in rank_gate_unmodelled. Ladder as read: accept at the desk, then examine an Ergon Locus in Cirdas Caverns. Step 1 has no bullet of its own -- the walkthrough opens at 'Travel to Cirdas Caverns', which presumes the assignment is already in hand -- so it is cited to bullet 1 and its NPC/zone/grid come from the Giver block, not from prose. Bullets 1 and 2 merge: bullet 1 is the journey, bullet 2 the interaction, and a journey with no named waypoint is not a markable rung. The page names TWO loci and either one satisfies the objective -- Sanctum of Life (E-9) and Prominence of the Soil (M-9), both behind a Colonization Reive -- so grid is null rather than picking one square the other assignment-taker would not use. The real difficulty is unmodellable: the locus must be examined from a distance band that rotates with Vana'diel time (six windows, 0.5-3.4), and no packet reports distance or game time. Bullets 3 and 4 are NOT steps -- they are lists of measured (time, distance) readings, one per locus, reference data for the positioning table above them. The walkthrough never describes returning to the Task Delegator or reporting, so no turn-in rung is recorded; inventing one would be importing a step this page does not have. Flagged walkthrough_incomplete so a human can rule on it.

notes:

THE PAGE CARRIES A giver_conflict -- the coalition page says (G-11), the Task Delegator NPC page says (G-10) -- and stage A took the NPC page. The objective is unusual and the ladder has to say so honestly: you must BE HIT by a chapuli's Sanguinary Slash, not kill anything. So the mob entry is a marker hint, not a kill requirement -- role 'kill' is the closest of the three roles the schema allows and count 1 is not a kill count (count_unobservable). The assignment spans two zones with a different chapuli in each -- Fernfelling Chapuli in Ceizak Battlegrounds or Calfcleaving Chapuli in Yahse Hunting Grounds, and EITHER satisfies it. A step has one zone and 'group' means an unordered set you do ALL of, which would be a lie about an OR, so the step is placed in Ceizak Battlegrounds -- the zone this assignment is named for -- and the Yahse alternative is recorded here only (or_branch_unmodelled). Bullet 2 is an outcome, not a step ('the assignment will be complete'), so it merges into the fight; its sub-bullets are play advice (remove your shield, the move is at least conal so stacked characters can be done together). The page positively asserts completion on being hit and never describes returning to report, so no turn-in rung is recorded.

notes: Giver from the '## Giver' block: Task Delegator, Western Adoulin (G-10), Mummers' Coalition. Rank 'Probationer' gates the offer, has no schema field and is not gates.level -- rank_gate_unmodelled. gates.repeatable is the one gate this batch can actually assert, and only because bullet 4 says it in words: 'it is possible to warp back and forth from the Mummers' Coalition and rapidly repeat this quest once you figure out the proper emote/direction'. That is the page's own sentence, not the family assumption, so repeatable is true here and null on the other eleven records. Bullets 1-3 are one interaction with one NPC and become one rung: find the Station Worker, get the emote menu, pick the right emote while facing both the worker and a compass direction. Consecutive rungs on the same NPC are one marker, so they are not split. The emote and the direction both rotate every three Vana'diel hours; the eight windows for Foret de Hennetiel are in the step note, and nothing about game time is observable, hence time_gated. Morimar Basalt Fields is the page's equally valid alternative zone with its own eight-row column; a step has one zone and 'group' means do-all, so the step sits in Foret de Hennetiel -- the zone this assignment is named for -- and the alternative is recorded in prose only (or_branch_unmodelled). NO GRID: this page never gives the Foret de Hennetiel frontier station a square, and taking one from a sibling Deliver page would be exactly the import this pipeline forbids. Bullet 4 is a repeatability remark, not a step. The page describes completion at the emote and never a return to the desk, so no turn-in rung is recorded.

Speak to the Station Worker at the frontier station, then pick the right emote from the menu while facing BOTH the worker and the listed compass direction (the direction is where you face, not where you stand). Grid is null because this page never gives the station a square. Foret de Hennetiel windows: 00:00-03:00 Look pleased (NW); 03:00-06:00 Cry a River (N); 06:00-09:00 Act Surprised (NE); 09:00-12:00 Rue your life (E); 12:00-15:00 Cheer (SE); 15:00-18:00 Pretend to be flustered (S); 18:00-21:00 Blush like a maiden (SW); 21:00-00:00 Rally the troops (W). Morimar Basalt Fields is an equally valid alternative with a different rotation and is not modelled. First-person view helps line the direction up; a dialogue after each attempt says whether the direction or the emote was wrong.

Item written singular from the plural phrasing, '3 Jars of Umbril Ooze' -> name 'Umbril Ooze' count 3; the wikilink target is Umbril Ooze and 'Jar of Umbril Ooze' resolves to the same item id, so the short form is used. notes:
Kill work, and the count is the interesting part. Giver from the '## Giver' block: Task Delegator, Eastern Adoulin (F-7), Peacekeepers' Coalition, giver_conflict null. Rank 'Probationer' gates the offer, has no schema field, is not gates.level -- rank_gate_unmodelled. The objective is 'Vanquish 5 Toads'; the walkthrough names two species and joins them with 'and/or' -- 'Defeat 5 Rustwater Toads and/or Spoutdrenched Toads' -- which means FIVE TOTAL in any mix, not five of each. The schema has no way to share one count across two mob entries, so 5 is written on both and this note carries the truth; count_unobservable and or_branch_unmodelled flag it. In practice this costs little: kill counts in this addon are display-only, they never advance a rung or decide a marker, and both species are legitimate marker targets in the same zone. Credit does not require EXP range as long as you are in Rala Waterways when your party or alliance kills them, and the page warns that AoEing them credits only one kill. Sub-bullet travel advice: the closest entrance is from Western Adoulin southeast of the Mog House, and the toads are in the southwest corner of the zone -- no square is given for them, so grid stays null. The walkthrough never describes returning to the desk or reporting, so no turn-in rung is recorded.
